fieldKit.description: A reusable playbook for one field. From Step 5 of the v4 skill: a router, task playbooks, domain principles, role definitions, verification and cleanup routines, and a capability map, plus a lever the agent can actually drive.

area.description: A question type or task area the kit covers.

cleanup.description: How temporary state is removed without removing evidence.

endToEndCheck.description: Each kit names its end to end check for the field.

steps.description: The exact steps a human user would take on the real artifact.

field.description: What the kit is for, in a few words.

lever.description: The tool or API the agent can actually drive, not just prose.

path.description: Kit folder path, or repo URL only if actually published there. Never invent a repo link.

pattern.description: The recurring task pattern this playbook handles.

principles.description: Short, testable rules for the field, not generic advice.

router.description: Matches a task to the right playbook for the field.

versionDigest.description: Digest of the kit version the run used.

graph.description: The graph that orders the work. From the Graph section of the v4 skill. Loop is how to retry a fail. Graph is how to order the work.

decision.description: Item 1, Router. The reason is written in the graph file.

handoffs.description: Item 8, Handoff pattern. Agents are nodes, and handoffs are edges alongside tool calls. A handoff is a transfer of control between agents, not a dependency between units.

from.description: Name of the unit the agent hands off from.

to.description: Name of the unit the agent hands off to.

limits.description: Item 4, Loop per node. Up to 5 fix cycles per run, shared across units. Dead end for a unit only after 3 distinct approaches for the same failure class.

unit.description: Item 2, Units and links. Each unit has one output file or folder, one owner, one check. A unit with no output file is not a unit.

dependsOn.description: Names of units this unit needs. A link means the later unit needs the earlier unit output. No entries means parallel. Two or more entries makes this unit a join: it starts only after all of them exist, and never runs early.

passes.description: The unit's status. Starts as failing (false) for every unit. Only this field changes as the work runs. Done means every unit passes.

description: One file that describes a Handover field kit and the graph that runs with it. Matches Handover v4, skills/local-handover/SKILL.md. The diagram in docs/field-kit-and-graph-diagram.html is drawn from data that validates against this schema.
title: Handover field kit and graph
